user.title: BOM Flood Monitor
user.description: Choose the state whose river gauges you want to monitor.

data_description.state: Gauges near a border can appear under either state.

region.title: Choose a region
region.description: Each region is one of BOM's regional flood maps.

data_description.region: Add the integration again to monitor gauges in another region.

stations.title: Choose gauges
stations.description: Each gauge becomes a device with its own water level, flood status, trend and alerts.

data_description.stations: The number in brackets is BOM's station number. Gauges marked "no BOM flood levels" show a level but no flood status unless you add your own levels later in Configure.

scan_interval.title: Update interval
scan_interval.description: BOM publishes new water levels about every 15 minutes.

data_description.scan_interval: Polling more often than every 15 minutes rarely finds new readings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the BOM FTP server. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_gauges_found: BOM's map for this region returned no gauges. BOM may have changed the page; try again later.

abort.already_configured: This region is already set up. Use Configure on it to add or remove gauges.

init.title: BOM Flood Monitor options
init.description: Change which gauges are monitored and how often BOM is polled.

data_description.stations: Removing a gauge removes its device.

thresholds.title: Flood levels for unclassified gauges
thresholds.description:
BOM publishes no flood levels for: {gauges}.

These gauges show "No flood levels set" until you enter levels here. Enter the gauge height in metres at which minor, moderate and major flooding begins, or leave blank. Levels must increase from minor to major.

These are your own figures, not official BOM classifications. Always follow official BOM warnings and emergency services advice.

error.cannot_connect: Could not refresh the gauge list from BOM.
error.thresholds_order: Flood levels must increase: minor below moderate, moderate below major.
